question.problem:
Let $X$ and $Y$ be two continuous random variables with a joint probability density function

$$
f(x,y)=\frac{3x}{2({y}^{2}+1)},\,{y}^{2}\le x\le 1.
$$

Find the expression for the marginal PDF ${f}_{Y}(y).$
question.worked_solution:
If $X$ and $Y$ are two continuous random variables with joint probability density function $f(x,y),$ then the marginal density functions for $X$ and $Y$ are

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X}(x)={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }f(x,y)\,\text{d}y,\,{f}_{Y}(y)={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }f(x,y)\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

First, let's sketch the region $D=\{(x,y)\,:\,{y}^{2}\le x\le 1\}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14272472/assets/cf0c8438253a5b46a468610ca62bc17a9ce927c98045eb461291d98644241e2f.png)

In our case, the marginal density function of $Y$ for $-1\le y\le 1$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y}(y) & ={\int }_{{y}^{2}}^{1}\frac{3x}{2({y}^{2}+1)}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{3}{2({y}^{2}+1)}{\int }_{{y}^{2}}^{1}x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{3}{2({y}^{2}+1)}{[\frac{1}{2}{x}^{2}]}_{x={y}^{2}}^{x=1} \\  & =\frac{3}{4({y}^{2}+1)}[1-{({y}^{2})}^{2}] \\  & =\frac{3}{4({y}^{2}+1)}[1-{y}^{4}] \\  & =\frac{3(1-{y}^{2})(1+{y}^{2})}{4({y}^{2}+1)} \\  & =\frac{3(1-{y}^{2})}{4}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the full expression for ${f}_{Y}(y)$ is given by

$$
{f}_{Y}(y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{3(1-{y}^{2})}{4}, & -1\le y\le 1, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$
